questions.q: In Unity Catalog, what kind of object is a Delta share?
options: A static file export with no further governance
A securable object — owned, permissioned, and auditable like a catalog or table
A temporary cache that expires after 24 hours
A copy of the data stored outside Unity Catalog entirely
questions.explain: A share is itself a Unity Catalog securable object, with an owner and its own grants — Delta Sharing extends the governance model rather than bypassing it.

questions.q: Which SQL statement adds a table to an existing share?
options: CREATE RECIPIENT ... ADD TABLE
GRANT SELECT ON TABLE ... TO SHARE
ALTER SHARE share_name ADD TABLE table_name
INSERT INTO SHARE share_name VALUES (table_name)
questions.explain: ALTER SHARE ... ADD TABLE is the real syntax for adding a table (optionally with PARTITION, COMMENT, or WITH HISTORY clauses) to a share.

questions.q: What does CREATE RECIPIENT ... USING ID set up?
options: A token-based external recipient requiring an activation link
Databricks-to-Databricks sharing, identified by the other party's metastore ID
A new Unity Catalog metastore
A scheduled job that re-runs the share daily
questions.explain: USING ID takes the recipient's Databricks metastore ID, enabling Databricks-to-Databricks sharing without managing bearer tokens. Omitting USING ID is what creates a token-based recipient instead.

questions.q: Which statement answers the audit question "who currently has access to this share?"
options: DESCRIBE SHARE share_name
SHOW GRANTS ON SHARE share_name
SELECT * FROM share_name
EXPLAIN SHARE share_name
questions.explain: SHOW GRANTS ON SHARE lists every recipient currently granted access to that share — the lesson's named first stop for an access audit.

questions.q: Per this lesson, what's the recommended way to limit what a recipient sees in a shared table?
options: Always share the full raw table so the recipient can filter it themselves
Add the share to a different catalog
Share a view that already has column masks or row filters applied, not the raw table
Rename the columns before sharing so the recipient can't identify them
questions.explain: The same Chapter 2–3 governance tools (masks, row filters) still apply before data reaches a share — granting SELECT on an already-governed view keeps the share's exposure to the minimum needed.
